title: Introducing Trash Buttons
mainText: We're excited to announce the addition of trash buttons to your inbox! Now, managing your messages is easier than ever. Simply delete messages directly from your inbox, and they'll be permanently removed.

title: Unlock Hindi Quiz Generation
mainText: Dive into a new dimension of learning with our latest feature: Hindi quiz generation! Now, you can effortlessly generate quizzes for any article in Hindi. Give it a try and expand your knowledge!
